[Arising out of impugned final judgment and order dated 26-02-2020  in CRLMA No.4143/2020 passed by the High Court of Gujarat at  Ahmedabad]
 ALKABEN JITESHBHAI GAJARIYA Petitioner(s)
 VERSUS  STATE OF GUJARAT & ANR. Respondent(s)
 (IA No. 40634/2020 - EXEMPTION FROM FILING C/C OF THE IMPUGNED  JUDGMENT, IA No.40636/2020 - EXEMPTION FROM FILING O.T.)

sentences.text:
Having heard learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of the material on record, the interim order passed on 22.05.2020 is made absolute, subject to the condition that the petitioner shall continue to cooperate with the pending investigation, if any, and 17:05:55 IST Reason:
in case the charge-sheet has been filed, she will fully cooperate with the Trial Court and shall appear regularly unless granted exemption.

2. The special leave petition is, accordingly, disposed of.
3.
All pending applications, if any, also stand disposed of.

4. This petition is directed against the order dated 29.01.2021, whereby the High Court declined to quash the proceedings arising out of FIR No.I.2/2023, registered under Sections 407, 420, 467, 468,
471, 120B read with Sections 114 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

5. When the matter came up for hearing on 19.04.2021, it was simply tagged with SLP(Crl.)
No.2058/2020, without issuing notice and/or granting stay of the proceedings.
Meanwhile, the investigation was completed and the charge-sheet has been filed.
6. That being so, we dispose of this petition with liberty to the petitioner to raise all the contentions before the Trial Court at an appropriate stage.
Such contentions shall be considered by the Court concerned as per their own merits.
7. The special leave petition is, accordingly, disposed of.
8. All pending applications, if any, also stand disposed of.

(ARJUN BISHT) (PREETHI T.C.)
